description:
Affected extensions: custom-footer.ex, tools.ex
Upstream: ctx.sessionManager.getBranch() returns all entries on the current session branch (the path from root to leaf). Used by:
  - custom-footer.ts: iterates branch entries to sum token usage (input/output/cost) for display.
  - tools.ts: scans branch entries for 'tools-config' custom entries to restore persisted tool selection state when navigating branches.
Current workaround: token stats and git info are omitted from custom-footer; tools.ex does not restore from branch entries.
What's needed: Context must expose a branch entry list (or lazy accessor). Entries should include type, customType, data fields matching what appendEntry/custom entries emit.
Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/custom-footer.ts + tools.ts
title: ctx.sessionManager.getBranch() — expose current branch entries to Context
